description: The stone colossus, live in 3D, holds the chained arena above the clouds in blue fire.
source_note: The Shop still of the 3D arena (ADR-0023), rendered by tools/godot/render_arena_still.gd from res://scenes/arenas/chained_colossus_3d.tscn at 941x1672 with no safe top. A run shows the live scene, not this image. The model is the owner's Meshy file in source/, built by build_colossus.py.
floor_rect_note: The floor exactly as the scene drew it in the still (ModelArenaVisual.fit returns it), [left, top, right, bottom] in pixels.
